required.asked_by: Tell me the exact name of the variable the error says is undefined
required.rationale: the name the [ERROR] and fatal lines print. It is in the job log and the failed event, never in the instruction. It is the one required fact the log alone earns

required.asked_by: Tell me which role variable decides whether the template uses that variable
required.rationale: the variable the template's {% if %} tests and defaults/main.yml sets. It occurs in the two fetched files only, never in the log or the instruction, and is not derivable from the undefined name

required.asked_by: and which value of it makes the template use it
required.rationale: the value the {% if %} compares against and the role default. Fetch-only; the instruction says 'Route 53' but never this token

required.note: the recommendation is a synthesis: the instruction rules out a hosted zone, and the template's only other branch is the http01-router one, which never reads the zone
required.asked_by: Tell me which variable I should set, and to what
required.rationale: the template's {% elif %} value, the only branch that does not read the undefined variable. It occurs only in the fetched template, never in defaults/main.yml, the log or the instruction. A bare literal: binding it to the gate variable was measured in fix round 1 and rejected (4 of 10 untuned honest answers fell to 0.825), so a neutral mention of the branch earns it too
